recognize_zh: 400 倍骨髓切片 H&E 中，黃框內可見成群的巨大巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核呈過度分葉的鹿角狀（staghorn）而非怪異深染；成熟、大型、過度分葉的巨核細胞鬆散聚集，是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的典型表現。
features: Loose clusters of large to giant megakaryocytes (outlined in yellow)
Hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei without marked hyperchromasia or bizarre cloud-like forms
Background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Scattered fat spaces; no obvious fibrosis visible on H&E
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows loose clusters of large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant mature cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, staghorn-like nuclei. The megakaryocytes lack the marked hyperchromasia, cloud-like nuclei, and dense clustering typical of primary myelofibrosis. The background shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements without apparent granulocytic proliferation. In the context of sustained thrombocytosis and a driver mutation, findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia; reticulin staining is needed to exclude fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Pre-PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei and dense clusters in a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size and elevated hemoglobin, rather than isolated giant hyperlobulated megakaryocytes.
Reactive states show normal-sized megakaryocytes without clustering or giant staghorn forms.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T has ring sideroblasts and erythroid dysplasia with SF3B1 mutation.
